purpose_context: Three upgrade migrations (2.1.3 restore_prompt_commands, 2.1.4 enforce_command_file_state, 3.1.2 globalize_commands) read the operator's home directly rather than through uses_centralized_runtime(), so the same commit can take a different migration path on two machines. This mission measures them at the real upgrade entry point and makes the classification a function of the project's own stamp (issue #6954).
purpose_tldr: Make three upgrade migrations decide from the project, not the operator's home
